entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Be careful. If my prediction is correct,[n]that one's a bit problematic for us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's up with that one? It's mumblin'[n]to itself, but... it's not makin' any moves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Alright, then I'll go take care of it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It started moving after we attacked it...[n]Looks like it's exactly what I expected.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Once we take it down— Hey, you two![n]Watch this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll explain later! Focus on the battle[n]for now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's another one like from earlier...[n]Haphazard attacks on it will only make[n]things tougher for us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's probably best to take it down fast[n]by striking its weakness and getting it[n]to blow up.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Alternately, we could put it to sleep[n]or make it unable to move, then just[n]deal with it later.
